review_findings.message: The statement summary (source-0007) provides explicit account descriptions, types, owners, and valuations for three Holloway accounts. Observations 0010, 0011, and 0012 correctly extract these but omit proper field_state for missing account_ids (should annotate as not_stated). They do not explicitly cite the verbatim evidence from the source in their supporting text. Required fix: Include the OCR evidence as the direct excerpt for the relevant fields and annotate null account_id fields with not_stated.

evidence.source_text:
Holloway ISA (Robert) | Stocks & Shares ISA | £70,000 | 30 Apr 2026
Holloway ISA (Jean) | Stocks & Shares ISA | £66,000 | 30 Apr 2026
Holloway GIA (Joint) | General Investment Account | £30,000 | 10 Mar 2026

review_findings.message: Observation-0005 omits to identify that H-CASH-JE (Cash Account for Jean Fletcher) is present in the client data db (source-0001) but does not provide a value. The extracted account is present, but the value is null. No field_state is provided for missing value, currency, or valuation_date, which should be annotated as not_stated or explicitly_missing per extraction field definitions.

Observation-0030 (unclassified) refers to a 'small cash account' for Jean mentioned in source-0003. The extraction does not fully reflect that the account_id, platform, account_type, and owner_text are all genuinely not stated in the meeting note. It should set all of these as null/not_stated and ensure that field_states for these missing properties are provided, referencing the evidence for their absence.

evidence.source_text: Jean mentioned in passing that she has another small cash account from some years ago, but she could not recall the balance and was not even sure it was still active. She will dig out the paperwork and we will confirm it before anything is finalised.
